notes.title: V0.3.5 Update Notice.
notes.notes: [h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a defeated Monster interrupted the Hero’s attack animation—battles are now smoother.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the gold icon display error during Moon Notification (Quick Hide) mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where an empty dialogue box appeared at the Altar after switching to the Sun Button in Quick Hide mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug allowing Monster summoning during the Boss phase—now summoning is disabled during Boss fights.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Optimizations[/h3][list][*][p]Sun/Moon Button (Quick Hide): Now auto-adjusts size based on game resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]The upgrade button of Decor becomes unclickable at max level, keeping the interface clean.[/p][/*][*][p]Sacrificing a Rare Hero (i.e., a shiny card in the Hero Collection) boosts the chance of hatching a Rare Hero from the egg.[/p][/*][*][p]Eggs with multiple genes (the four icons below age in the Hero info panel) now have a lower chance of hatching single-gene Heroes.[/p][/*][*][p]The Altar now has a rare chance to summon UR Heroes.[/p][/*][*][p]Healing clicks for Heroes increased to a max of 10 per second (up from 2), with adjusted healing amounts and improved Healing Tree efficiency.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Loafing Town Demo is released!
notes.notes: [p]Hey there! The [i]Loafing Town[/i] demo is out now, and we’re super excited for you to jump in and give it a spin! If you run into any hiccups or have cool ideas to make the game even better, leave a message in our Steam Community or e-mail us.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598082/19f5ba6791c12012cc964a4b69dfd7e2ef90c977.png"][/img][/p]

notes.notes: [p]Loafing Town, your sneaky desktop slacking buddy, is dropping its demo on August 15! Get a taste of 20% of the full experience — curious? Add it to your wishlist now![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598082/19f5ba6791c12012cc964a4b69dfd7e2ef90c977.png"][/img][/p]
